'''Aren D'skaun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]], who worked on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He served as a "contact" for individuals seeking to gain entry to the [[Underburn]] region of the station.
